blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Loren Legarda on Friday filed a legislative resolution seeking to investigate the alleged dumping of remains of dogs and cats in San Jose del Monte, Bulacan. Legarda, through Senate Resolution No. 759, aims to open a Senate probe into reports involving Ahjay Paws Aftercare Pet Crematorium in Bacoor City, Cavite, which reportedly disposed of the deceased bodies of several animals. READ: Dead pets dumping in Bulacan: Senators seek tougher measures; probe set “Our pets are cherished members of our families.
